strings.bars_done: Bars drawn. Red/blue swapped: try 'bgr'. White/black ends swapped: try 'invert'.
strings.bus.help: Open the SPI host and panel IO
strings.bus_ready: Display bus ready: CLK=%d, MOSI=%d, CS=%d, DC=%d at %d kHz
strings.close.help: Delete the panel and IO, and free the host
strings.color_invalid: '%s' is not a colour name or 0xRRGGBB
strings.edges.help: Draw a per-side border and a corner marker: the orientation and offset tool
strings.edges_done: Edges drawn. A missing coloured side means the gap on that axis is off; noise on one side means the gap is too large.
strings.fill.help: Fill the screen with a solid colour
strings.gap.help: Set the panel gap and redraw edges
strings.gap_invalid: Gap x and y must be numbers
strings.grid.help: Draw a 1px grid over the whole display area
strings.grid_step_invalid: Grid step must be a number 2 or greater, not '%s'
strings.group.help: Display over SPI: transport, panel registry, test patterns
strings.info.help: Show host, pins, panel and the commands that reproduce this state
strings.info_host: Host:    %s, CLK=%d, MOSI=%d, CS=%d, DC=%d at %d kHz
strings.invert.help: Invert the panel's colour data and redraw bars
strings.no_backlight_pin: No backlight pin was given to 'display bus'
strings.no_panel_note: Run 'display panels' for the parts this firmware knows, then attach one (for example 'display-st7789 init 240 320').

not_initialized.text: Display not initialized. Run 'display bus <clk> <mosi> <cs> <dc> ...' first.

strings.orient.help: Swap and mirror axes, then redraw edges
strings.orient_invalid: swap_xy, mirror_x and mirror_y must each be 0 or 1
strings.out_of_frame: %dx%d with gap %d,%d does not fit the panel's %dx%d controller RAM in either orientation
strings.panels.help: List the panels this firmware can drive
strings.pin_absent: GPIO %d does not exist on this chip
strings.pins_numeric: CLK, MOSI, CS and DC must be pin numbers
strings.sd_holds_host: The SD card holds the SPI host. Release it with 'sd close' first.
strings.spi_holds_host: The spi group holds the SPI host. Release it with 'spi free' first.
